description.en: TSH {expenses} in expenses and no income are recorded for this period. Check that all sales and receipts have been entered.
description.sw: Matumizi ya TSH {expenses} yameandikwa bila mapato katika kipindi hiki. Hakikisha mauzo na stakabadhi zote zimeingizwa.

description.en: Recorded income changed by {incomeChangePercent}% from the previous period. Identify what worked and whether it can be repeated.
description.sw: Mapato yaliyorekodiwa yamebadilika kwa {incomeChangePercent}% kutoka kipindi kilichopita. Chunguza kilichosaidia na kama kinaweza kurudiwa.

description.en: Recorded income changed by {incomeChangePercent}% from the previous period. Review sales activity, opening hours and missing entries before deciding what to change.
description.sw: Mapato yaliyorekodiwa yamebadilika kwa {incomeChangePercent}% kutoka kipindi kilichopita. Kagua mauzo, muda wa kazi na miamala inayoweza kuwa haijaingizwa kabla ya kufanya mabadiliko.

description.en: Recorded expenses changed by {expenseChangePercent}% from the previous period. Check the largest cost items and confirm each one is necessary.
description.sw: Matumizi yaliyorekodiwa yamebadilika kwa {expenseChangePercent}% kutoka kipindi kilichopita. Kagua gharama kubwa na uthibitishe kila moja ni muhimu.

description.en: Recorded expenses changed by {expenseChangePercent}% from the previous period. Check that the change reflects actual savings and not missing records.
description.sw: Matumizi yaliyorekodiwa yamebadilika kwa {expenseChangePercent}% kutoka kipindi kilichopita. Hakikisha ni akiba halisi na si taarifa zilizokosekana.

description.en: The largest expense category accounts for {topExpenseSharePercent}% of recorded expenses. Review its transactions and consider setting a budget.
description.sw: Aina ya matumizi iliyo juu zaidi ni {topExpenseSharePercent}% ya matumizi yaliyorekodiwa. Kagua miamala yake na fikiria kuweka bajeti.

description.en: There are {expenseTransactionCount} expense entries and {incomeTransactionCount} income entries in this report. Check whether all transactions are categorized and recorded consistently.
description.sw: Kuna miamala {expenseTransactionCount} ya matumizi na {incomeTransactionCount} ya mapato kwenye ripoti hii. Hakikisha yote yameainishwa na kurekodiwa kwa utaratibu mmoja.

title.en: Use this result as an early signal
title.sw: Tumia matokeo haya kama ishara ya awali

description.en: Only {transactionCount} transactions are included. Record consistently for a fuller picture before making major business decisions.
description.sw: Miamala {transactionCount} pekee ndiyo imejumuishwa. Rekodi miamala kwa utaratibu ili kupata picha kamili kabla ya maamuzi makubwa.

title.en: Plan how to use the positive balance

description.en: Recorded income exceeds expenses by TSH {net}. Consider planned restocking, savings or other priorities before spending the remainder.
description.sw: Mapato yaliyorekodiwa yamezidi matumizi kwa TSH {net}. Panga ununuzi wa bidhaa, akiba au vipaumbele vingine kabla ya kutumia salio.

description.en: Expenses exceed recorded income by TSH {net}. Verify the entries, then identify costs to manage or income opportunities to follow up.
description.sw: Matumizi yamezidi mapato yaliyorekodiwa kwa TSH {net}. Hakiki miamala kisha tambua gharama za kudhibiti au fursa za mapato za kufuatilia.

description.en: Average income entry: TSH {averageIncome}; average expense entry: TSH {averageExpense}. Review larger expense entries and confirm they are expected.
description.sw: Wastani wa muamala wa mapato: TSH {averageIncome}; wastani wa matumizi: TSH {averageExpense}. Kagua miamala mikubwa ya matumizi na uthibitishe kuwa ilitarajiwa.

description.en: {overdueTasks} visible tasks are overdue. Contact the assignees, update deadlines where needed and record the next action.
description.sw: Kazi {overdueTasks} zinazoonekana zimechelewa. Wasiliana na waliopewa kazi, sasisha muda inapohitajika na rekodi hatua inayofuata.

description.en: {tasksForReview} submitted tasks are waiting for review. Schedule a short review so staff can get approval or feedback.
description.sw: Kazi {tasksForReview} zilizowasilishwa zinasubiri ukaguzi. Panga muda mfupi wa kuzikagua ili wafanyakazi wapate idhini au mrejesho.

description.en: {activeTasks} visible tasks are active. Confirm priorities, assignees and due dates are manageable.
description.sw: Kazi {activeTasks} zinazoonekana zinaendelea. Hakikisha vipaumbele, wahusika na tarehe za mwisho zinawezekana.

title.sw: Kagua mchanganyiko wa mauzo ya POS

description.en: {posSalesCount} POS sales totaling TSH {posSalesTotal} were recorded. Review frequently sold items and check that stock levels are kept current.
description.sw: Mauzo {posSalesCount} ya POS yenye jumla ya TSH {posSalesTotal} yamerekodiwa. Kagua bidhaa zinazouzwa mara nyingi na hakikisha viwango vya stock vinasasishwa.

title.sw: Kagua shughuli za wafanyakazi kwa usawa

description.en: {staffCount} staff accounts are registered. Compare recorded activity using the same dates, shop filters and responsibilities before drawing conclusions.
description.sw: Akaunti {staffCount} za wafanyakazi zimesajiliwa. Linganisha shughuli zilizorekodiwa kwa tarehe, vichujio vya duka na majukumu yanayofanana kabla ya kufanya hitimisho.

title.sw: Tumia aina za matumizi kwa utaratibu

description.en: Categorized entries make reports easier to compare. Use the same category for similar purchases and check uncategorized transactions.
description.sw: Aina za miamala hurahisisha kulinganisha ripoti. Tumia aina ileile kwa manunuzi yanayofanana na kagua miamala isiyoainishwa.

description.en: {incomeTransactionCount} income entries are included. Compare totals with receipts, invoices or payment records to catch omissions or duplicates.
description.sw: Miamala {incomeTransactionCount} ya mapato imejumuishwa. Linganisha jumla na stakabadhi, ankara au taarifa za malipo ili kubaini zilizokosekana au kurudiwa.

description.en: {expenseTransactionCount} expense entries are included. Keep supplier receipts and compare them with the entries in this report.
description.sw: Miamala {expenseTransactionCount} ya matumizi imejumuishwa. Hifadhi stakabadhi za wauzaji na zilinganishe na miamala kwenye ripoti hii.
